title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Recognition of the Validity of Divorce Judgments of Foreign Courts upon Application by Chinese Parties to the People's Court

articles.content_en:
Reply on the Issue of a Chinese Party Applying to the People's Court for Recognition of the Validity of a Foreign Court's Divorce Judgment
Fa (Min) Fu [1990] No. 12
Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province:
Your request titled "Request for Instructions on Issues Concerning a Party's Application for Recognition of the Validity of a Foreign Court's Divorce Judgment" has been received. Upon review, we consider that where a Chinese party holds a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court and applies to the People's Court for recognition of its validity, such application shall be accepted by the Intermediate People's Court. Upon examination, if the foreign court's judgment does not violate the basic norms of the laws of our country or the interests of the State or society, a ruling shall be made to recognize its validity; otherwise, the application shall be rejected by ruling. No appeal shall be allowed after the ruling.
August 28, 1990
